scheme_name: Patrakar Kritadnyata Nidhi Scheme (Journalist Benevolent Fund)
other_conditions: The applicant must be born and brought up in Goa
The applicant must have worked continuously for at least three years in a newspaper establishment in Goa
The applicant must be registered with the Department of Information and Publicity, Government of Goa and renew the registration by 30 June each year
The applicant must not be engaged in any other profession
benefits_summary: Financial assistance up to ₹2,00,000 per case for emergencies such as medical treatment, marriage, funeral, self‑employment and scholarships for journalists' wards.
documents_required: Copies of mandatory documents (self‑attested, if required)
Original bills and photocopies of hospital/institution documents for medical claims
